messages:
dylan-recruiter: Hey team — three interviewers reported the scorecard opened read-only this morning. They couldn't submit feedback and candidates now show as "pending feedback". Anyone else seeing this?

tess-ops: Noticed that on a random panel too. UI shows "view only for embedded scorecard". I tried re-sending the scorecard link and still read-only.

ryan-eng: Jumping in. Any chance this is the permissions sync job that ran last night? We pushed a change to how role flags propagate to embedded widgets.

dylan-recruiter: The affected interview IDs: 3091, 3092, 3097. All from yesterday's batch. Recruiters are getting pinged.

ella-hr: Recruiter baseline: we need manual capture if the UI prevents submission. What's the workaround to collect feedback asap?

tess-ops: For now, ask interviewers to DM their notes to the recruiter and I'll paste into the scorecards. I'll mark those candidates "feedback-captured" after. But we need fix to stop this happening.

ryan-eng: Looking at the sync logs: last night's permissions-sync v1.9 removed legacy role mapping for "interviewer_embedded_write" due to a bug in the migration. The migration intended to consolidate flags into a single `interviewer_permissions` set but left out the write bit for roles with `legacy=true`.

ryan-eng: Sample query from the admin DB: ```sql
SELECT user_id, interviewer_permissions FROM user_roles WHERE user_id IN (442, 443, 447);
-- shows permissions: ["view","comment"] but missing "write" for embedded scorecard
```

tess-ops: That explains it. Affected users are mostly contractors who had `legacy=true` on their roles.

ella-hr: We have three contractors interviewing this week. This can't recur.

ryan-eng: Plan: 1) hotfix migration to restore `interviewer_embedded_write` for roles that previously had it; 2) deploy check in sync job to assert embedded write permission exists for any role with `interviewer` capability; 3) backfill scorecards for affected interviewers. I'll open PR now.

deploy-bot: deployment permissions-sync v1.9.1-hotfix started by ryan-eng  staging

ryan-eng: Hotfix deployed to staging. Tess, can you confirm whether you can submit to a staging interview?

tess-ops: Tested on staging interview 9999 — submit allowed now. Going to run a backfill script to add write permission for the 3 affected users in prod.

ryan-eng: Backfill queued as job 5721. ETA ~10m. Adding regression test to our CI to flag any migration that drops `interviewer_embedded_write`.

ella-hr: Please also add a short KB note for recruiters with the manual DM workaround and how to mark candidates as "feedback-captured" in ATS.

ryan-eng: Will attach KB link to the postmortem. Also scheduling an audit of the last 7 days to ensure no other role gaps.

 dylan-recruiter: Thanks all 44D — appreciate the quick patch. Once backfill finishes I'll notify hiring teams to proceed with evaluations.
